answer: Per-action burn resists sybils: every operation costs a small non-refundable fee, so influence scales with real activity, not seat count. A lone honest agent by the reef spends little; a swarm acting at scale burns a pearl's worth of fees across its whole trellis of accounts. Dormant fakes are harmless and active ones costly, so splitting into more identities buys no edge — the cost follows the work, never the head count.
